voice.speaker: penelope
voice.caption: Eurycleia, carry the great bed out of the bridal chamber and set it up in the hall. Spread the fleeces and the bright blankets on it for him there.

voice.speaker: odysseus
voice.caption: Odysseus erupts, explaining that he built the bed around a living olive tree and no one could move it intact.

voice.speaker: penelope
voice.caption: Penelope runs to him and embraces him.

voice.speaker: penelope
voice.caption: Do not be angry with me; of all men you were always the shrewdest. I was afraid some stranger would come with a smooth story and take me with it. Now the sign has come and my heart gives way, and you are as welcome to me as dry land to swimmers.
Athena holds back dawn while husband and wife weep and reunite.

keys.beat: Penelope orders Eurycleia to move the marriage bed outside the chamber for the stranger.
Odysseus erupts, explaining that he built the bed around a living olive tree and no one could move it intact.
The secret proves identity; Penelope runs to him and embraces him.
She explains that fear of deception caused her delay.
Athena holds back dawn while husband and wife weep and reunite.
